en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a historic market square bordered by traditional half-timbered houses and a large building with a clock tower and steep roof. A fountain or column stands in the center of the cobblestone square. Shop signs and awnings are visible, including one reading "Eduard Lönne" on the right. At the bottom, printed in red Gothic-style script, it reads "Wernigerode a. Harz. Marktplatz.." indicating the town and location.
